report.step_customer_desc:
Please enter the information below to generate your personalized real estate report.
Your name will be used to verify the payment account, and your email will be used to send the completed report.
The report fee is 29,900 KRW, and your report will be generated and sent via email within 24 hours of payment verification.
report.step_budget_desc:
'Available Cash' refers to the cash/equity you can actually use, and 'Loan Limit' refers to the additional amount you can borrow.
For example, if your available cash is 300 Million KRW and your loan limit is 200 Million KRW, complexes will be recommended based on a total budget of 500 Million KRW.
report.step_location_desc:
First, select either 'Public Transport' or 'Driving', then set your frequent location on the map below.
This is typically your workplace. Recommended complexes will consider commute times to this location using your selected transport method.
report.step_preferred_districts_desc: Select up to 4 preferred districts (cities/counties). Complexes within these districts will be prioritized for recommendation within your budget.
report.step_priorities_desc:
Set the priorities for the items you care about. These weights will be factored into the complex recommendations.
Setting equal weights for all items will result in balanced recommendations.

notice.title: Notice from Realrankus
notice.coffeechat_title: Celebrating {years} Years of Sustainable AI Service | Realrankus
notice.coffeechat_desc: Since launching in 2022 as a solopreneur, I have built market trust through continuous data updates and refinement. I welcome light coffee chat proposals regarding the service's future vision or collaboration.
notice.intro_desc1: Realrankus is an AI-powered service that evaluates location data for 'Living', 'Transit', 'Infra', and 'Edu' to calculate scores and rankings.
notice.intro_desc2: Realrankus scores exclude 'Price' and 'Topographic Elevation', which means the results may differ significantly from your expectations.
notice.intro_warning: Please note that Realrankus scores are not investment indicators, and all responsibility for investment decisions lies with the investor.
notice.kakao_channel_alert: Update notifications are delivered via our KakaoTalk Channel.
notice.bullet_1: Please note that Realrankus scores are not investment indicators. All responsibility for investment decisions lies with the investor.
notice.bullet_2: All scores are determined by AI analyzing environmental factors, with no manual manipulation whatsoever.
notice.bullet_3: Scores are relative values within the respective district, and a score does not represent the same value in other districts.
notice.bullet_4: Complexes with 80 units or fewer are excluded from statistics.
notice.bullet_5: For reconstruction complexes, the housing score is calculated using the floor area ratio and building coverage ratio.
notice.bullet_6: Transit scores in the Seoul metropolitan area are calculated based on subway station location data.
notice.bullet_7: Infrastructure data is calculated based on website information from department stores/marts, the Korea Federation of Banks, the Resource Circulation Information System, and the Public Data Portal.
notice.bullet_8: Education data is calculated based on information from the Educational Statistics Service.
notice.bullet_9: District data is calculated based on information from the Public Data Portal.
notice.bullet_10: All information is scheduled to be updated once a month, subject to changes depending on the update timing of the source data.
notice.bullet_11: For inquiries, error reports, or suggestions, please contact us via email or KakaoTalk.
